target_applications: consumer home chores: dish clearing, dishwasher loading, laundry folding, tidying, coffee/espresso prep

base_type.value: wheeled platform with central telescoping column (no legs)

height_mm.note: rests ~1220mm (4 ft); envelope floor to ~2130mm (7 ft) arm reach

reach_mm.note: max vertical reach ~7 ft with arms; can also touch floor

torso_lift.value: telescoping central column, floor-touch to ~7 ft work envelope

max_speed_ms.note: trained to move at ~50% of human pace

actuators.value: not disclosed; compliant control, limbs safe to push mid-task; passively stable when powered off

end_effector.value: simplified 3-finger gripper co-designed as mirror of Skill Capture Glove; demonstrated two-glasses-in-one-hand grasp

sensors_head.value: cameras (details not disclosed); cartoon face with eye-slits

sensors_wrist_hand.value: hand mirrors sensor layout of sensorized Skill Capture Glove (details not disclosed)

software_stack.value: proprietary; ACT-1 (11/2025) long-horizon mobile manipulation; ACT-2 preview (07/2026) 99.1% zero-shot laundry folding, 785 trials, unseen homes; trained on ~10M glove-collected episodes; Skill Transform pipeline ~90% fidelity; 'Solve' evaluation standard

safety_compliance.value: no certifications disclosed; safety via static stability, compliant limbs, 50% human speed, lightweight silicone-shelled body

price.value: not announced; ~$20k hand-built cost today; >=50% cost cut at scale claimed; sub-$10k retail target

availability.value: beta 'Founding Families' late 2026 ('by Thanksgiving'), US; waitlist ~1,000 (03/2026)

deployment_evidence.value: no customer deployments yet; WIRED-observed live demos (espresso, dishwasher, glasses); 2,000+ paid glove data collectors, ~10M episodes

notes: Funding: ~$200M total; $165M Series B @ $1.15B post (2026-03-12, Coatue). Founders Tony Zhao (Mobile ALOHA/ACT) and Cheng Chi (Diffusion Policy/UMI). Data strategy: paid 'Memory Developers' wearing ~$200-400 Skill Capture Gloves instead of teleoperation.
